_role: Blended wing body / lifting body (B-2, Horten register). One of the two hulls the SDF pipeline genuinely suits better than the old convex-hull approach: the whole point is a CONTINUOUS blend from centre body into wing with no hard join, which is exactly what smooth-min does for free. Wide span (10 x 1.5 x 6), thin section, faired canopy rather than a proud box.

primitives._note: Centre body - an ellipsoid rather than a box, so it blends into the wings instead of meeting them at an edge.

Left wing panel, swept back. Thickness (0.72) is deliberately well above one voxel at this resolution - at 0.50/res18 the wings vanished entirely and the hull baked 4.57 wide instead of 10.80. High smoothness fairs the root into the body.
Right wing panel, mirrored sweep. Same minimum-thickness constraint as the left.
Faired canopy blister on the dorsal ridge (CANOPY is the Z-elongated dome from the primitive kit) - the spec's 'real cockpit volume, not just a bump'.
Nose fairing - keeps the leading edge from reading as a blunt ellipsoid cap.
